item.title: Liquid AI Benchmarks LFM2.5-2.6B Running 16 Concurrent Streams on Apple Silicon
item.summary: Liquid AI showcased its 2.6-billion-parameter LFM2.5-2.6B agentic model running up to 16 concurrent inference streams on a single Apple M5 Max Mac, positioning the model for zero-cost, fully on-device agent workflows with no cloud dependency.
